name: raider
theme: a sun-baked desert junk lot of rusted cars and broken concrete
description: A wasteland raider in patched brown leather and scrap-metal armour: a rusted steel panel cut from a car door bolted over the left shoulder, a dented chest plate cut from an old road sign, a black rubber gas mask with one round filter, a torn dark red sash at the waist, worn canvas trousers bound with straps, heavy desert boots, gripping a wooden club studded with nails in the right hand
